text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: That is the schedule we have in mi...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kh! To think a mere headache would make
my 
handwriting so crooked...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's the rain or what,
but 
it's infuriating to no end—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hnghhh--! To think I cannot even write a 
single straight line...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after, Calstone Light O would 
continue to nurse that lingering 
headache...
